note: The problem appears to have been posed around 2011 based on indirect evidence. A 2021 preprint (arXiv:2108.02363, Akbar, Akrobotu & Brewer) states in its conclusion that the line-graph question 'settl[ed] the open question known for about a decade,' which would place the problem's origin circa 2011. The field of word-representable graphs itself was established by Kitaev and Pyatkin in their 2008 paper 'On representable graphs,' and open problems in the field are discussed in Kitaev and Lozin's 2015 book 'Words and Graphs,' but the exact year and original source for this specific line-graph conjecture could not be definitively located in the available literature. The problem was definitively resolved (in the negative) by a 2025 preprint (arXiv:2509.03339, Mozhui, Dwary & Krishna).
